subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should OpenClaw treat WebChat reconnect as resuming the same active run contract, and should that be fixed in the linked PR #41067 or a narrower current-main repair?
rationale: Current main has partial reconnect mitigations but not full active-run adoption, and the linked PR overlaps session-state/message-delivery behavior with proof and compatibility concerns that require maintainer direction.

options.title: Finish focused reconnect recovery
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a focused fix that adopts server in-flight run state in WebChat and proves reconnect behavior end to end.

options.title: Route through PR #41067
options.body: Use the open recovery PR as the canonical vehicle if maintainers want its broader restart-notice and snapshot changes after proof is added.

options.title: Narrow scope to queued sends only
options.body: Close or split the active-run portion only if maintainers decide queued-send recovery is the supported reconnect contract and in-flight run adoption is intentionally out of scope.

recommendation.title: Finish focused reconnect recovery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a focused fix that adopts server in-flight run state in WebChat and proves reconnect behavior end to end.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership signals point to this person across the affected Control UI and gateway chat paths.
